meta.title: Session migration
meta.description: In Settings → Session migration, move sessions older than a chosen number of months out of the DSH session list and restore them later. The range supports 0–120 (0 means all sessions, including this month). Sessions with a note or todo are kept by default and must be explicitly allowed and selected. Pending and migrated lists group by workspace and then by last activity month, showing Git branch, parent session, note/todo text and DSH archive state. The default archive directory is $DSH_HOME/session-migrator/archive; another absolute directory can be entered manually.
